contents.title: How the Web Works
contents.description: Understand how browsers communicate with servers to display websites. Learn the fundamentals of HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP, URLs, and how web pages are delivered over the internet.
contents.author: MDN Web Docs

contents.title: How does the Internet work? (Full Course)
contents.description: Explore how the internet connects computers around the world. This beginner-friendly course explains routers, switches, ISPs, networks, and the infrastructure behind internet communication.
contents.author: freeCodeCamp.org

contents.title: Code: The Hidden Language of Computer Hardware and Software, 2nd Edition
contents.description: Discover how computers work through engaging explanations of binary, logic gates, circuits, and hardware. Charles Petzold uses everyday examples to make complex computing concepts understandable.
contents.author: Charles Petzold

contents.title: Machine Learning Crash Course
contents.description: Learn the foundations of machine learning through interactive lessons covering regression, classification, neural networks, datasets, model evaluation, and responsible AI practices.
contents.author: Google for Developers

contents.title: Machine Learning Crash Course: Intro & What's New
contents.description: Discover Google's updated Machine Learning Crash Course and explore how modern machine learning education covers foundational concepts, generative AI, interactive exercises, and practical learning.
contents.author: Google for Developers

contents.title: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow, 3rd Edition
contents.description: Learn practical machine learning through Python examples and exercises. Explore data preparation, regression, classification, neural networks, deep learning, and modern AI architectures.
contents.author: Aurélien Géron

contents.title: Usability 101: Introduction to Usability
contents.description: Understand the fundamentals of usability and user-centered design. Learn about learnability, efficiency, memorability, user errors, and how usability testing improves digital experiences.
contents.author: Jakob Nielsen

contents.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners
contents.description: Learn interface design using Figma through practical demonstrations. Explore shapes, typography, colors, components, auto layout, responsive design, prototyping, and complete UI projects.
contents.author: freeCodeCamp.org

contents.title: The Design of Everyday Things
contents.description: Explore the psychology behind effective design and everyday interactions. Learn how affordances, feedback, usability, and human-centered thinking influence the products and interfaces people use.
contents.author: Don Norman

contents.title: What is Product Management? A Guide for Product Managers and Agile Teams
contents.description: Understand the role of product management in building successful products. Learn how product managers connect customer needs, business objectives, engineering teams, research, and product strategy.
contents.author: Max Rehkopf

contents.title: What is product management? - Agile Coach
contents.description: Learn what product management involves through insights from an experienced Atlassian product manager. Explore product vision, team alignment, shared understanding, and building useful products.
contents.author: Atlassian

contents.title: INSPIRED: How to Create Tech Products Customers Love, 2nd Edition
contents.description: Discover how successful technology companies build products customers love. Learn about product discovery, product strategy, team collaboration, customer needs, and effective product development.
contents.author: Marty Cagan

contents.title: What is DevOps?
contents.description: Explore the principles and practices of DevOps, including collaboration between development and operations teams, continuous integration, continuous delivery, automation, reliability, and infrastructure management.
contents.author: Amazon Web Services

contents.title: What is Cloud Computing? | Amazon Web Services
contents.description: Get introduced to cloud computing and understand how organizations access computing power, storage, databases, and other services over the internet without maintaining physical infrastructure.
contents.author: Amazon Web Services

contents.title: The Phoenix Project: A Novel About IT and DevOps
contents.description: Follow an IT team struggling with a critical business project and discover practical DevOps principles through storytelling. Explore workflow management, collaboration, constraints, and continuous improvement.
contents.author: Gene Kim, Kevin Behr, and George Spafford
